name: Special City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by
  the Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956. The special meeting will be
  held in-person for the City Council and staff, and via teleconference for members of
  the public, only, in order to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and
  pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20.

  No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and
  offer public comment will be provided. Please listen to the meeting, which will be live
  streamed at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo.

  Public comment on agenda items is welcome and members of the public may submit
  written correspondence to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us to be read into the
  record for any item on which they would like to comment. Members of the public may
  also submit comments by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262, extension 200.
  Comment submitted before 4:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting will be read until the
  time limit of three minutes has been reached.

  All votes taken during this meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly
  reported, as required by law.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  (to be held during Covid-19 emergency)

  MONDAY, JUNE 14, 2021
  6:00 P.M.

  LOCATION FOR CITY COUNCIL AND STAFF:
  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVE.
  ARTESIA, CA 90701

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC MAY VIEW MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

SPECIAL MEETING PROCEDURES
As a result of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, states of emergency have been
declared in the County of Los Angeles and the state of California. The President of the
United States has declared a federal emergency. At the direction of the Governor, starting
March 19, 2020, the entire state is subject to stay-at-home orders. These measures are
imposed to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19. To comply with these emergency
measures, the City Council meeting will be open and public but conducted via
 teleconference only for members of the public. City Councilmembers and staff may
teleconference into the meeting or physically attend at the Albert O. Little Community
Center, which will be closed to members of the public. The City is endeavoring to employ
technology that will allow the public to view the meeting live and participate.

Public comments may be submitted by email to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us, or by
voicemail to (562) 865-6262, extension 200. Public comments received by voicemail will
be transcribed. Please submit email and voicemail public comments by 4:00 p.m. on the
date of the meeting to ensure that the comments are read into the record.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
Under California law, public comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the
agenda only. Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will
be read at this time.

DISCUSSION ITEMS

  1. SPECIFIC PRESENTATION OF BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-2022, AND
  ADOPTION OF PROPOSED SPENDING PLAN FOR THE CITY’S ALLOCATION
  OF AMERICAN RECOVERY PLAN ACT 2021

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.

CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, JUNE 14, 2021
  6:00P.M.
The Special Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 6:00 p.m., on Monday,
June 14, 2021 in the Albert O. Little Community Center by Mayor Rene Trevino.

PRESENT:  Rene Trevino, Mayor
  Melissa Ramoso, Mayor Pro Tem
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember
  Monica Manalo, Councilmember

ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Hong Dao Nguyen, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Interim Finance Manager
  Karen Lee, Interim Assistant Finance Manager

MEETING PROCEDURES

THE CITY CLERK READ THE MEETING PROCEDURES AS FOLLOWS:
To comply with emergency measures, the City Council meeting will be open and public but
conducted via teleconference only for members of the public. This way the public, the staff, and
the Council will not be physically in the same place. City Councilmembers and staff may
teleconference into the meeting or physically attend at the Alberto O. Little Community Center,
which will be close to members of the public. The City is endeavoring to employ technology that
will allow the public to view the meeting live and participate. Public comment must be submitted
by email to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us, or by voicemail to (562)865-6262 ext. 200.
Submission should be limited to 300 words or less and must be received prior to the posted start
time of the meeting.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE AGENDA

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM RAMOSO

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was adopted without objections, 5-0-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

  The City Clerk presented the Announcement Regarding Public Comments, and reported
  that there are no public comments.

ITEMS FOR CONSIDERATION

  Page 1 of 2
   1. SPECIFIC PRESENTATION OF BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-2022, AND
  ADOPTION OF PROPOSED SPENDING PLAN FOR THE CITY’S ALLOCATION OF

  City Manager provided a Staff Report.

  City Manager answered question regarding item.

  Councilmember Taj asked questions regarding item.

  City Manager answered questions regarding item.

  Councilmember Taj provided additional comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso provided comments and questions regarding item.

  City Manager answered questions regarding item.

  Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso provided additional comments.

  Mayor Trevino asked questions regarding item.

  City Manager answered questions regarding item.

  Mayor Trevino provided comments.

  City Manager provided comments.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  No comments from City Council.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Trevino adjourned the meeting at 7:00 p.m.
